fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-10-29 states that Gunasekar Murugan was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Thendral Nagar ATM Area, on 2025-10-29 around 13:45 hrs. Padmini Raj (9000000032) reported the matter for Gunasekar Murugan, whose contact number is given as 9000000210. The complainant alleged that Dinesh Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000212. A witness, Buvaneswari Sri, reachable on 9000000294, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
fields.Keywords: altercation, street dispute, suspect, witness, mobile number, ATM area, witness statement, afternoon
